notes: Read both targets and full context. Preserve the climate/economic double-risk qualification and attribute the conservation quotation to Theodore Roosevelt; quote the passage only as needed for speaker identification, not as narrator speech. Do not extract Climate Prize or international cooperation policies from context.

claims.claim_text: A strong economy will be essential to addressing climate-change risks.
Commitment to reasonable climate policies that do not require Americans to sacrifice their way of life or reduce their aspirations for their children.
The world's poorest people would suffer severely from either severe climate change or a severely impaired world economy.
Commitment to prevent both severe climate change and severe damage to the world economy.
The Republican environmental perspective reflects longstanding appreciation of nature and gratitude to God for natural resources available to Americans.
President Theodore Roosevelt argued that conserving natural resources was fundamental and that solving other problems would have little value without conservation.
Support for Theodore Roosevelt's view that natural-resource conservation is fundamental to the value of solving other problems.
Americans of all backgrounds share a commitment to protecting the environment and its recreational opportunities.
Support for public access to public lands for recreation, including hunting, hiking and fishing.
